name: 11435 · Jamaica, NY
findings: ZIP 11435 (Jamaica) has 187 nonprofit organizations. 55 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11435 (Jamaica) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
89% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
